extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors or users attempting to create/find an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating or locating a Wikipedia article when a title returns a “no article” notice, including account requirements, searching existing content, and troubleshooting deleted or delayed pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: No exact-match article exists
rubrics_metrics.description: Wikipedia does not have an article with this exact name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no exact-match article exists, search for alternative titles or spellings and consider creating a new article following Wikipedia's creation process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unregistered or non-autoconfirmed users cannot create new pages; ensure you meet the account and autoconfirmed status before attempting to create an article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If unsure about directly creating a full article, use the article wizard to prepare a draft for review or use the requests process to ask experienced editors to create the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for the title in existing articles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Roseanne specials" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, search Wikipedia for the phrase and for related/alternative titles to avoid duplication and to find existing coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check backlinks and linked references to discover mentions or existing coverage that might use a different title or redirect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Possible database delay / purge suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect the page to exist (e.g., you or someone else recently created it), wait briefly or purge the page to force an update before re-creating.

rubrics_metrics.name: Case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Try alternative capitalizations and, if you create a page under one variant, consider adding redirects so readers using different capitalizations find the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a page previously existed but was deleted, consult the deletion log and relevant help pages to understand the reason and whether recreation is appropriate or requires discussion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check sister projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for Roseanne specials on one of Wikipedia's sister projects: Wiktionary (dictionary), Wikibooks (textbooks), Wikiquote (quotations), Wikisource (library), Wikiversity (learning resources), Commons (media), Wikivoyage (travel guide), Wikinews (news source), Wikidata (linked database), Wikispecies (species directory).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Related content may exist on sister projects; check them for definitions, media, quotes, data, or other related materials before creating a Wikipedia article.
